run_token_classification: run the TokenClassificationPipeline to extract named entities from input text using Stanza
create_ner_pipeline: create a TokenClassificationPipeline instance with a HuggingFace Stanza model ID for NER
extract_named_entities: extract named entities with entity type, word, start and end offsets from text
run_upos_tagging: run universal POS tagging on text when no NER model is configured in the pipeline
review_token_classification_pipeline: review the TokenClassificationPipeline class to understand NER and UPOS fallback behavior
